individual_results.explanation: The agent made partial progress by navigating to Yelp and searching for CVS pharmacies in Chicago, visiting a CVS pharmacy page (CVS Pharmacy Loop Chicago). However, the agent appears to be stuck in a loop of clicking actions without completing the task. There is no evidence of: (1) reviewing customer reviews to evaluate service quality, (2) selecting a best-rated location, (3) navigating to the official CVS website, or (4) walking the user through the prescription refill process. The agent never sent any message to the user to communicate findings or provide guidance.
